data_source: eval_sets/*.txt — genuine native-script sentences, finance-domain, SMALL (~15-40 words/lang); NOT a large held-out general corpus. Indicative, not definitive.
honest_finding: Most Indic scripts (esp. Dravidian: Malayalam/Tamil/Telugu/Kannada) exceed the 1.8 tokens/word gate even on favorable in-domain text. The tokenizer does NOT pass its own Indic gate. Agglutinative Dravidian morphology is inherently token-dense; a flat 1.8 target may be unrealistic for them.
recommendations: Source a real held-out corpus (FLORES-200 / AI4Bharat IndicCorp) for a definitive measurement — current samples are too small.
v0.4 tokenizer: allocate more merges/vocab to Dravidian scripts, or a per-script byte-fallback tuned for Malayalam/Tamil/Telugu.
Replace the flat 1.8 gate with per-script targets (e.g. Indo-Aryan <=1.8, Dravidian <=2.2) with a documented rationale.
Re-measure hinglish (2.13) — code-mixing inflates fertility; consider more Latin-Indic subwords.
